events.title: FTSE 100 Climbs As Realty Stocks Rally On Housing Initiative
events.description: UK equities advanced Monday with the benchmark index up 28.65 points to 10,723.90. Strong gains in homebuilder shares followed government announcements of support for first-time buyers, offsetting oil market volatility.

events.title: Dollar Keeps Rising Amidst Bond Selloff, Rate Hike Worries
events.description: The U.S. Dollar extended gains during the week ended September 25 as strong economic data from the U.S. and the spike in global crude oil prices renewed Fed rate hike fears and triggered a selloff in U.S. bond markets.

events.title: CAC 40 Flat As Oil Surge Fuels Inflation Concerns
events.description: France's equity benchmark CAC 40 held near flat Monday as rising oil prices from renewed U.S.-Iran tensions weighed on investor sentiment. Brent crude futures climbed 3.7% amid supply concerns.

events.title: Indian Shares Slump Amid Oil Price Surge
events.description: Indian shares slumped on Monday as rising oil prices added to inflation and interest-rate concerns.

events.title: Yen Rises Amid BoJ Rate Hike Speculation
events.description: The Japanese yen strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Monday, as traders expect that the Bank of Japan or the BoJ is likely to raise its interest rates soon in the next month's policy meeting.

events.title: German Stocks Mixed As Iran Tensions, Oil Surge Weigh
events.description: German stocks traded mixed Monday amid U.S.-Iran tensions and rising oil prices. Brent crude surged to $108.28 after Trump rejected Iran's proposal on the Strait of Hormuz. The DAX edged up 0.11% to 25,424.50 at noon.

events.title: Gold Dips Below $4200 On Fed Hike Bets
events.description: Gold prices fell sharply on Monday as surging oil prices and elevated bond yields added to worries that the U.S. Federal Reserve will continue raising interest rates next month.

events.title: Oil Prices Surge Amid US-Iran Stalemate
events.description: Oil prices jumped more than 3 percent on Monday in the wake of renewed concerns about energy supply as U.S. President Donald Trump rejected Iran's latest proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and signaled possible new military strikes after midterm elections.

events.title: Yen Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Japanese yen strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Monday.

events.title: European Shares Rise As UK Unveils Homebuyer Support Plan
events.description: European stocks were modestly higher on Monday despite concerns over rising oil prices and elevated bond yields after U.S. President Donald Trump rejected an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end the war.

events.title: Asian Shares Mixed As Inflation And Fed Worries Mount
events.description:
Asian stocks ended mixed on Monday as Middle East tensions persisted, hawkish signals from Federal Reserve policymakers bolstered the case for another Fed rate hike this year, and new data showed China's industrial profit growth slowed further in August.
 
Oil prices and bond yields extended their climb as U.S. President Donald Trump rejected Iran's latest proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and signaled possible new military strikes after midterm elections.

events.title: Swiss Franc Slides Against Majors
events.description: The Swiss franc weakened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Monday.

events.title: European Shares Seen Subdued As Hormuz Reopening Hopes Fade
events.description: European stocks are seen opening on a cautious note on Monday due to continued uncertainty over the end to the U.S.-Iran war in the Middle East after U.S. President Donald Trump rejected Iran's latest proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and signaled possible new military strikes after midterm elections.
